narr: Isolated showers and thunderstorms initially began across parts of southern Gila County, along with eastern Maricopa County and northeast Pinal County, producing locally heavy rainfall leading to isolated flash flooding. By the late afternoon and early evening hours on the 20th, new thunderstorms initiated over the high terrain of northern Arizona. High instability (MUCAPE 2,000-2,500 J/kg) aided in maintaining strong to severe thunderstorms into the Phoenix area as thunderstorms pushed toward the south and into the lower deserts during the evening. DCAPE around 1,000-1,200 J/kg promoted strong to severe downbursts with the strongest thunderstorms. Meanwhile, PWATs around 1.7-1.9 aided in thunderstorms being heavy rainfall producers, leading to several reports of flash flooding. No injuries were reported.
ev: Videos showed considerable flow in Bloody Tanks Wash, impacting Schulze Ranch Road. No damage or injuries were reported.
ADOT reported that SR 238 was closed due to flooding. Timing and exact location estimated from radar. No damage or injuries were reported.

A video showed a wash flowing across a low water crossing along Silver King Road, making the road impassable. Other videos in the Queen Valley area also showed high flow in Queen Creek. Timing estimated from radar. No damage or injuries were reported.
MCDOT reported that Patton Road between 195th Avenue and 203rd Avenue was closed due to flooding. No damage or injuries were reported.

A FCDMC streamflow gage along Sols Wash exceeded alarm stage, making a low water crossing along Vulture Mine Road impassable. At 0424MST, the gage peaked at a depth of 3.65 feet and a flow of 3,822 CFS. A social media video showed Sols Wash flowing across Vulture Mine Road and Wickenburg dispatch reported the road was closed as a result of the flooding. No damage or injuries were reported.

Flow in Centennial Wash caused a low water crossing along Centennial Park Road to become impassable. An RV attempted to cross the flooded roadway but was swept off the road. Images also showed damage to the roadway from the flooding. No injuries were reported.
